description: Run exactly N physics frames, then leave the game paused (pauses it first if needed). Deterministic: every pausable node gets the same N _physics_process calls, independent of call latency. press/release/tap are sent just before the first stepped frame, like real input, so the game sees them in that frame as Input.is_action_just_pressed() and as input events (tap lasts one frame) — input sent with game_input while paused can't do that.

frames.description: Physics frames to run (60 per second by default).

press.description: Actions to press before the first frame and keep held.

release.description: Held actions to release before the first frame.

tap.description: Actions to press for exactly the first frame.

name: game_step
title: Advance running game by N frames
